title: csnotes sources: inventory command with use counts
description:
csnotes sources [--course C] [--unused] [--dormant] [--untagged] [--json].
- Group by course tag (untagged gets its own group); show kind, status, and a use count: number of _synthetic notes whose frontmatter contributing_sources lists the source_id. Compute at query time (walk _synthetic frontmatter); no new manifest field, so it can't go stale.
- Mark dormant sources (see dormancy issue).
- status.rs: replace the per-source list with one line, e.g. 'Sources: N unused for active courses · M dormant → csnotes sources'. Keep --json output backward-compatible or version it.
- Edge: credited source_ids that aren't registered/active (SU vault: Zybooks 12-recursion, 13-exceptions, 15-collections are credited but staged). Show them as credited and note the status.
- Tests: use counts from fixture notes; filters; status summary line.
- SU vault check: 15 of 35 'unprocessed' sources should show as used.
